title: 第257章 和沈凝霜独处第256章 进入主殿
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
第257章和沈凝霜独处
不过她多看了李飞一眼，目光在他手指上那枚古朴的黑色储物戒上停了一瞬，眉头微微一挑，似有所觉，但什么也没有说。
陆沉在一旁松了口气。
他就知道两人会拒绝，不过柳珑的态度也比他想象中要友善得多。不愧是帝国学府的大佬，格局就是不一样。
“既然你们是陆沉的兄弟，又是第一次来中州，对陨仙殿不熟悉，那就一起吧。”
沈凝霜开口，语气淡淡的，但目光在看向陆沉时，又微微弯了一下眼角，像是在笑。
“陆沉是我欣赏的后辈，他的兄弟，自然也是我的后辈。”
“多谢前辈提携！”
两人行礼。
随即，众人便一同踏入了主殿之中。
踏入主殿的瞬间，所有人都被眼前的景象震住了。
殿内自成一方天地。
头顶不是穹顶，而是一片浩瀚的星空，无数星辰在深紫色的天幕上缓缓流转。
脚下也不是石板，而是一层薄薄的云雾，踩上去软绵绵的，每一步都会荡开一圈浅浅的涟漪，像是行走在水面上。
但，这些却都不是真的，只能起到一个造型上的作用。
众人远处悬浮着数十座大小不一的浮空平台，每一座平台上都有一座独立的建筑。
有的是剑台，有的是丹阁，有的是藏书楼，还有的只是一处处大殿，但每一处都散发着令人心悸的古老气息。
“这是……小空间嵌套？”
柳珑环顾四周，眼中闪过一丝凝重。
“这位陨仙大能生前的修为，恐怕比我们预估的还要高。能在秘境中再开辟一方如此完整的小空间，绝对不是渡劫期的手段，而是……仙！”

沈凝霜微微颔首，目光在那些浮空平台上扫过，最后落在正中央那座最高的剑台上。
剑台顶端悬浮着一柄巨大的石剑，剑身斑驳，布满裂痕，但依然散发着一股凌厉到让人不敢直视的剑意。
即便隔了这么远，那股剑意依然刺得人皮肤生疼。
“既然有这么多处传承试炼之所，那各位就各凭本事，分头探索。”柳珑转身对学府的众人吩咐道。
“遇到危险立刻捏碎玉符，不要逞强。这里的试炼因人而异，强求不得。”
学府的合体期和大乘期修士们纷纷点头，各自选了一个方向掠去。
有的飞向那座剑台，有的朝丹阁而去，有的则直奔几块刻着上古文字的石碑处。
很快，入口处便只剩下陆沉、沈凝霜、柳珑，以及林天和李飞。
“你们两个小辈，跟我走吧，毕竟你们是和我一起进了主殿，那现在你们就是学府的人，我不能让你们在我眼皮子底下出事。”
林天和李飞对视一眼，又看了看陆沉。
陆沉朝他们点了点头，两人才跟着柳珑朝一座石碑的方向飞去。
content_en:
Chapter 257 Being Alone with Shen Ningshuang
However, she took another look at Li Fei, and her eyes paused for a moment on the simple black storage ring on his finger. She raised her eyebrows slightly, seeming to be aware of it, but said nothing.
Lu Chen breathed a sigh of relief on the side.
He knew that the two would refuse, but Liu Long's attitude was much friendlier than he imagined. He is worthy of being the boss of the Imperial Academy, but the structure is different.
"Since you are Lu Chen's brothers, and this is your first time in Zhongzhou, and you are not familiar with the Fallen Immortal Palace, then let's come together."
Shen Ningshuang spoke in a calm tone, but when she looked at Lu Chen, she slightly bent her eyes, as if she was smiling.
"Lu Chen is a junior that I admire. His brother is naturally also a junior of mine."
"Thank you, senior, for your support!"
The two saluted.
Immediately, everyone stepped into the main hall together.
The moment they stepped into the main hall, everyone was shocked by the sight in front of them.
The hall is a world of its own.
The top of the head is not a dome, but a vast starry sky, with countless stars slowly flowing on the deep purple sky.
It is not a stone slab under your feet, but a thin layer of clouds and mist. It is soft and soft when you step on it. Every step will create a circle of shallow ripples, like walking on water.
However, these are not real and can only play a modeling role.
Dozens of floating platforms of different sizes were suspended in the distance, with an independent building on each platform.
Some are sword platforms, some are alchemy pavilions, some are libraries, and some are just main halls, but every place exudes a heart-stopping ancient atmosphere.
"Is this... small space nesting?"
Liu Long looked around, a trace of solemnity flashing in his eyes.
"The cultivation level of this great fallen immortal was probably higher than we expected. To be able to open up such a complete small space in the secret realm is definitely not a means of overcoming the tribulation period, but... an immortal!"
Shen Ningshuang nodded slightly, her eyes swept over the floating platforms, and finally landed on the highest sword platform in the center.
There is a huge stone sword suspended at the top of the sword platform. The sword body is mottled and full of cracks, but it still exudes a sword intent that is so fierce that people dare not look directly at it.
Even though they were so far apart, the sword intent still stung people's skin.
"Since there are so many places for inheritance trials, everyone should explore separately according to their abilities." Liu Long turned around and ordered everyone in the academy.
"Crush the jade talisman immediately when in danger, and don't show off. The trials here vary from person to person, so you can't force it."
The combined-stage and Mahayana-stage monks from the academy nodded one after another, and each chose a direction to swoop away.
Some flew towards the sword platform, some headed towards the Dan Pavilion, and some went straight to several stone tablets engraved with ancient texts.
Soon, only Lu Chen, Shen Ningshuang, Liu Long, Lin Tian and Li Fei were left at the entrance.
"You two juniors, come with me. After all, you entered the main hall with me, so now you are members of the academy. I can't let anything happen to you under my nose."
Lin Tian and Li Fei looked at each other and then at Lu Chen.
Lu Chen nodded towards them, and then the two of them followed Liu Long and flew in the direction of a stone monument.
